title: The Air We Breathe
logline: A struggling mining outpost is put into crippling debt when the regional state retroactively classifies breathable air as a taxable imported luxury.

roles.description: Trying to keep their station breathing without bankrupting the workers.
Furious, exhausted, building illegal life support in the cargo bays.
Views breathing as a taxable event; meticulously notes every violation.
An unlicensed bulk freighter converted into a massive, jury-rigged air scrubber.
A deep-space rock where oxygen is the biggest weekly expense.
Organized labor pushed to the brink of violent revolt over basic needs.
The bureaucratic machine extracting wealth from the outer systems.

public_situation: The {role:governor_office} has enacted a new 'Atmospheric Usage Tariff', bankrupting independent stations overnight.
private_truth: The official air quality monitors are deliberately rigged to over-report consumption, forcing the outposts deeper into debt so the state can repossess them.

beats.public_change: The outpost disables its public spaces to save air, forcing everyone into cramped residential blocks.

missions.reason: Needs raw ice delivered off the books to be cracked into air by an illegal, homemade scrubber the union is building.
missions.private_fact: The manager is skimming from the corporate ore quota to pay for this, risking their own execution if caught.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to fetch specialized scrubber blueprints from a sympathizer.
missions.private_fact: The blueprints belong to a rival corporation.

beats.public_change: The state announces an audit of the outpost's wildly fluctuating air consumption data.

missions.reason: Needs an independent scan of the official state air monitors on the station's hull to prove they are malfunctioning.
missions.private_fact: The union rep already knows they are rigged, but needs a third-party pilot's flight logs to make the evidence legally admissible.

beats.public_change: The state discovers the illegal union scrubber ship and dispatches forces to destroy it.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to intercept and destroy the unlicensed scrubber ship for 'egregious tax evasion'.
missions.private_fact: The collector gets a percentage of the outpost's total debt when it is finally repossessed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the proof of the rigged monitors.
resolutions.summary: The public outrage forces the governor to repeal the tax and void the debts. The tax collector is scapegoated and fired.

consequences.public_summary: Someone proved the state was taxing thin air, and the governor had to back down.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot keeps quiet and destroys the scrubber ship.
resolutions.summary: The outpost is suffocated by debt and seized by the state. The union leaders are arrested for tax evasion.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the union's offer to defend the scrubber ship.
resolutions.summary: The scrubber ship survives, allowing the outpost to declare independence from the state's air supply. The debt remains, but they can finally breathe.

loose_threads.detail: The newly appointed corporate overseer shares an exact surname with the local tax collector.
The rigged firmware on the air monitors was pushed via a secure military update channel.

radio_hooks: {role:governor_office} defends new Atmospheric Tariff as 'necessary conservation measure'.
Wildcat strikes reported at {role:mining_outpost} over failing life support.

voice_direction.station_manager: Measured, speaks slowly to conserve breath.
voice_direction.union_rep: Loud, passionate, speaks in rapid bursts.
voice_direction.tax_collector: Smug, overly formal, uses long bureaucratic words to justify cruelty.
